wheel.metadata:
Metadata-Version: 2.4
Name: residual-agent-harness
Version: 0.5.0
Summary: A hybrid agent harness for counterexample-directed residual delegation
Requires-Python: >=3.11
Description-Content-Type: text/markdown
License-File: NOTICE
License-File: AUTHORS.md
Requires-Dist: defusedxml<1,>=0.7.1
Provides-Extra: marketplace
Requires-Dist: cryptography>=43; extra == "marketplace"
Provides-Extra: factory
Requires-Dist: cryptography>=43; extra == "factory"
Requires-Dist: PyYAML>=6; extra == "factory"
Provides-Extra: test
Requires-Dist: pytest>=8; extra == "test"
Requires-Dist: PyYAML>=6; extra == "test"
Provides-Extra: qualification
Requires-Dist: pytest==9.1.1; extra == "qualification"
Requires-Dist: PyYAML==6.0.3; extra == "qualification"
Requires-Dist: hypothesis==6.168.0; extra == "qualification"
Requires-Dist: coverage[toml]==7.16.1; extra == "qualification"
Dynamic: license-file
wheel.entry_points:
[console_scripts]
residual = residual.cli:main
residual-mission-sync = residual.station.mission_client:main
residual-module = residual.marketplace.cli:main
residual-station = residual.station.mission_server:main
residual-worker = residual.station.worker:main

[residual.modules]
netops = residual.modules.netops:NetOpsModule
secops = residual.modules.secops:SecOpsModule

validation.initial_source_attempt: pytest absent; unittest fallback could not load two pytest modules. Installed pytest and reran successfully.
